conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Superposition allows a quantum bit (qubit) to exist in multiple states simultaneously, unlike classical bits. Entanglement links the fates of two or more qubits, meaning they instantly influence each other regardless of distance.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For example, a classical bit is either a 0 or a 1, but a qubit in superposition can be both 0 and 1 at the same time. Entanglement means if you measure one entangled qubit, you instantly know the state of the other, no matter how far apart they are.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: So, these qubits can hold a lot more information, and entanglement allows them to work together in a unique way?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
